parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of particle board panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the shelves and door, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports other components.

parts.name: Shelf (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal shelf panel located near the bottom of the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the cabinet’s internal space.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: A middle shelf panel inside the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage levels for organizing items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and non-movable under normal conditions.

parts.name: Shelf (Top)
parts.Basic_description: A top shelf panel inside the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items placed near the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A front door panel made of MDF, attached to the cabinet frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior and protects stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.
